Compass Group announced the successful sale of its portfolio company, New Age Medical, a MedTech hub serving the spinal surgery market, to Avesi Partners.

Mason Wells announced today that it has completed the acquisition of The Cleveland Electric Laboratories Company (“CEL” or the “Company”). The Company is owned by Mason Wells, members of the current management team, and other board members and co-investors.

Founded in 1920, CEL is a leading manufacturer of thermocouple products used in high-temperature and demanding manufacturing environments. CEL also has a well-invested laboratory to certify products and materials to meet stringent customer and industry regulations and requirements. CEL operates two manufacturing locations, including its headquarters in Twinsburg, OH and a second facility in Tempe, AZ.

“We are excited about the opportunity to partner with Mason Wells and to continue the Company’s next phase of growth,” said Scott Puhalsky, Chief Executive Officer at CEL. “Mason Wells’ experience successfully supporting engineered product businesses will provide CEL the resources and network to achieve its long-term growth initiatives. TORONTO, ON and NEW CANAAN, CT, October 5, 2026 – Gridiron Capital, LLC (“Gridiron Capital” or “Gridiron”), an investment firm focused on partnering with founders, entrepreneurs, and management teams, today announced an investment in Weed Man (“Weed Man” or the “Company”), North America’s largest lawn care franchisor, to accelerate the Company’s next stage of growth. The partnership brings together Weed Man’s brand, franchise network, and operating track record with Gridiron’s experience building residential services businesses. Weed Man will continue to be led by Chief Executive Officer Jennifer Lemcke and its existing management team.

Weed Man provides season-long lawn care programs to residential customers across North America, anchored by fertilization and weed control and complemented by add-on lawn care services. Founded in 1970 as a single location in Ontario, Canada, the Company has grown into the largest lawn care franchisor in North America, serving more than 800,000 households across approximately 1,000 exclusive territories in 39 U.S. states and 10 Canadian provinces. Weed Man operates a model that pairs corporate-owned branches with a network of franchisee-owned locations, supported by centralized training, marketing, and proprietary operating technology.

The partnership underscores Gridiron’s leadership and conviction in its Residential Products & Services Thematic Area of Expertise™ and builds on the firm’s extensive experience with consumer-facing home and residential services businesses, including current and former portfolio companies Leaf Home, Erie Home, Legacy Service Partners, Greenix, and GarageCo. Working alongside the Weed Man team, Gridiron will draw on its Centers of Excellence and operational resources to accelerate growth across the Weed Man system, supporting customer acquisition and retention, geographic expansion, and continued investment in the franchise network.

Tom Burger, Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Gridiron, said, “Weed Man has spent more than five decades building a trusted national brand rooted in local ownership. Jen and her team have earned the trust of franchise owners and hundreds of thousands of homeowners, and we’re thrilled to welcome them to the Gridiron family. As former entrepreneurs and business operators, we understand the importance of preserving the culture, values, and local relationships that distinguish a business like Weed Man. We look forward to partnering with Jen and the team on the strong foundation they have built.”

Chris King, Managing Director at Gridiron, added, “From our first conversations with Jen and the Weed Man team, it was clear that the Company has built a differentiated business around a genuine commitment to supporting its franchisees and the homeowners they serve. With its respected brand, strong franchise network, and compelling operating model, Weed Man is well-positioned to build on its momentum in the large and growing residential lawn care market. We are honored to partner with the team in its next chapter of growth.”

Jennifer Lemcke, Chief Executive Officer of Weed Man, said, “This partnership represents the next chapter of a strategy we have been executing for years and is a testament to the work of our team and our franchise owners. We chose to partner with Gridiron because they understood our model and our people from day one, and because they share our commitment to supporting the long-term success of every franchisee in the system.”

Harris Williams served as financial advisor and Ropes & Gray LLP as legal counsel to Gridiron. KPMG Corporate Finance Inc. served as financial advisor and Torys LLP as legal counsel to Weed Man.

Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

CLEVELAND and DALLAS, October 7, 2026 – Align Capital Partners’ (“ACP”) national insurance investigative services platform Advantage Investigations (“Advantage” or the “Company”) recently completed the acquisition of NorStar Investigations (“NorStar”). This partnership brings together two established investigative organizations with a shared commitment to delivering exceptional service, reliable results and deep industry expertise.

Based in Fishkill, New York, NorStar provides surveillance, background checks, insurance fraud, insurance claim and legal investigations. The business primarily serves general liability insurance carriers, third-party administrators and law firms throughout New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania. The NorStar team will continue handling assignments and serving clients with the same professionalism, responsiveness and quality clients have come to expect.

“The acquisition enhances NorStar’s value proposition by providing access to the expanded national resources, technology and operational support of Advantage Investigations,” said NorStar Founder Bill Troiano. “We’re excited about the future as our team joins forces with Advantage to offer clients continuity with the same experienced personnel and investigative resources that have supported their results for years.”

“NorStar strengthens our presence in an important market and brings longstanding client relationships that complement Advantage’s existing capabilities,” said Advantage CEO Shelly Kummings. “We are pleased to have the NorStar team as part of Advantage and are committed to providing additional resources to support its clients.”

This marks the second add-on for Advantage since partnering with ACP in late 2025 and the Company’s sixth overall. Looking ahead, strategic acquisitions will remain an important component of Advantage’s growth strategy, with a focus on expanding capabilities, service offerings and geographic reach. Matt Iodice, Rob Langley, Stuart Schardin, Sarah Whitney and Joe Vitale worked alongside management on the transaction.

Disclosures: This press release is not an offer to sell securities or interests in any fund managed by ACP.

Goldner Hawn is pleased to announce that it has recapitalized, in partnership with management, International Filtration Services (“IFS” or the “Company”), a leading value-added distributor of industrial filtration solutions.

Mason Wells announced today that it has closed on the acquisition of Canworks, Inc. (“Canworks” or “the Company”), a leading digital printer for the beverage industry. The Company will be owned by Mason Wells, the founders and management, and other board members and co-investors.

Canworks is a direct-to-aluminum-can digital printer serving beverage brands across high-growth categories such as energy, wellness, hydration, craft beer, CBD and cannabis, ready-to-drink cocktails, ciders and seltzers, kombucha, among others. The Company’s offering includes digitally printed cans of various sizes and related products such as can ends and PakTechs, which are sold directly to brands and co-packers as well as through broker and distributor sales partners. Canworks delivers a comprehensive suite of solutions that beverage brands need to stand out in competitive markets – fast turnaround times and operational agility, short-run flexibility, premium graphic design, technical support, and an environmentally sustainable product offering. The Company operates five facilities in Austin, Texas (headquarters); Atlanta, Georgia; Vista, California; St. Louis, Missouri; and Windsor, Connecticut. Canworks was founded in 2020 by brothers Ryan and Marshall Thompson.

“We are excited about the opportunity to partner with Mason Wells and continue the Company’s growth,” said Ryan Thompson, Chief Executive Officer of Canworks. Marshall Thompson, President of Canworks, went on to say, “Our goal was to bring in a partner with significant experience scaling similar businesses at similar inflection points as Canworks. Mason Wells brings that in spades along with a dedicated focus on investing in the success of Canworks’ people and customers. That cultural alignment was extremely important to Ryan and me, and we look forward to continuing Canworks’ growth alongside Mason Wells.”

“Canworks is a special company with a customer-centric culture that’s unmatched in the industry,” said Damon Thome, Managing Director at Mason Wells. “We are thrilled to partner with Ryan and Marshall and the highly talented group of individuals at Canworks who are committed to delivering the best aluminum can decorating solutions to the beverage industry. Canworks’ geographic reach, technical excellence, and dedicated sales and support team make it an ideal addition to the Mason Wells family. We look forward to investing in the Company’s continued growth while maintaining the high levels of service and collaboration that Canworks is known for.”

Ryan and Marshall Thompson and Canworks’ management team invested alongside Mason Wells. Ally Corporate Finance provided financing for the transaction. Quarles & Brady represented Mason Wells as legal counsel.

Canworks is a direct-to-aluminum-can digital printer serving brands, co-packers, and brokers and distributors across all categories of the beverage industry. The Company operates five facilities across Texas, Georgia, California, Missouri and Connecticut. For more information, please visit the Canworks website at www.canworksprinting.com.

Mason Wells is a Milwaukee-based private equity firm that has raised $2.4 billion in aggregate across five independent buyout funds. The firm is currently investing out of Mason Wells Buyout Fund V, a $767 million fund. Since Mason Wells was formed in 1998, its buyout funds have invested in four specific industry sectors: Consumer Packaged Goods, Outsourced Business Services, Engineered Products & Services, and Packaging Materials & Converting. For more information related to Mason Wells, please visit the firm’s website at www.masonwells.com.

NRG Controls (the “Company”), a portfolio company of Fort Point Capital, announced the successful acquisition of Integrated Systems, Inc. (“ISI”), a highly regarded regional building automation systems integrator serving the Atlanta market. The combination with ISI adds a strategically important hub for NRG Controls in the Southeastern United States.

Integrated Systems, Inc. has been designing and implementing commercial HVAC control systems for more than 30 years. ISI installs and maintains DDC control systems in all types of buildings including educational facilities, warehouses, hospitals, commercial offices, medical offices, and laboratories.

“ISI has built an exceptional reputation over three decades by delivering high-quality, cost-effective installation and maintenance of controls systems to its customers” said Dave Sholtis, CEO of NRG Controls. “Our role is to continue to support that success with additional resources, expertise, and long-term stability.”

Through this partnership, ISI will gain access to NRG Controls’ broader service offering, including security, fire and life safety, and lighting. The partnership will also expand engineering and technical support, add enterprise level systems, and provide additional project delivery resources, enabling ISI to pursue more growth opportunities and better serve customers while preserving local decision making.

“ISI was built around providing the highest quality service to our customers, being there around the clock for them,” said Keith Carroll, CEO of ISI. “NRG Controls shares that same customer-first commitment and brings capabilities that will allow us to continue providing best-in-class service, with the enhanced support and offering of a larger organization.”

“We are excited to welcome Keith Carroll and the entire team at ISI to the NRG Controls family,” said David Sher, Vice President at Fort Point Capital. “This combination is an excellent opportunity for NRG Controls to continue to expand its footprint in the Southeast.”

The acquisition reflects NRG Controls’ continued investment in high-quality, locally operated businesses and its commitment to building a strong, scalable business rooted in regional expertise and relationships.

Vorys and Cohen & Co. advised NRG Controls on the transaction. Debt financing for the transaction was provided by Crescent Capital.

WASHINGTON, D.C., October 20, 2026 – ACR (AmerCareRoyal, LLC) acquires Minnesota-based Ultra Green Packaging (“Ultra Green”), a supplier of packaging for the foodservice, grocery and institutional markets. The transaction marks ACR’s twelfth add-on acquisition since Oridian Capital Partners’ initial investment.

Headquartered in Mound, Minnesota, Ultra Green designs and distributes fiber-based packaging and rPET packaging lids. Its molded fiber products include take-n-bake pizza trays, sushi trays and bakeware. The acquisition expands ACR’s PrimeWare™ line and adds packaging options for grocery and retail customers.

“Ultra Green expands our product breadth and strengthens our ability to meet the evolving packaging needs of foodservice and grocery customers,” said Scott Milberg, Chief Executive Officer of ACR. “Their molded fiber capabilities and compostable packaging credentials complement our existing portfolio. We look forward to bringing these products to a broader base of grocery and retail customers through ACR’s distribution network.”

“Ultra Green reflects the kind of business we seek out for ACR’s platform: an established company with specialized capabilities and a complementary product portfolio,” said Brendon Biddle, Managing Director at Oridian Capital Partners. “We believe combining Ultra Green’s molded fiber expertise with ACR’s infrastructure and customer relationships can create growth opportunities for the combined business.”

Ultra Green’s Kristin Davidson will remain actively involved following the acquisition, alongside key members of Ultra Green’s management team.

Fort Point Capital (“Fort Point”), a Boston-based private equity firm that invests in service-oriented businesses in the lower middle market, announced today that it has successfully completed the sale of its investment in AMS Fulfillment (“AMS” or the “Company”) to Stord, a commerce-enablement leader providing high-volume fulfillment services and e-commerce technology for leading brands headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.

Founded in 2002 by Jay Catlin and his partners in Valencia, California, AMS has grown from 15 employees serving a single client into a leading omnichannel fulfillment partner for premium consumer brands, with a particular focus on beauty and wellness. The Company provides a fulsome suite of direct-to-consumer and B2B retail fulfillment and freight management services, delivered through a high-touch, partnership approach to client service. AMS serves as the exclusive North American fulfillment provider for more than 95% of its brand partners.

Since its investment in 2019, Fort Point has worked closely with management to implement a sustainable growth strategy and provided the resources and tools necessary to scale the business. In partnership with Fort Point, AMS built a national fulfillment network, invested in its proprietary technology platform, including warehouse management with automation solutions, client support and shipping optimization tools, to become a premier high-touch fulfillment partner for digitally native and established consumer brands. In January 2020, AMS acquired Echo Data, an East Coast omnichannel fulfillment provider founded in 1991 with facilities in Pennsylvania and Delaware, establishing AMS’s bi-coastal fulfillment capabilities. In 2026, AMS completed its acquisition of Vox Fulfillment, adding more than 200,000 square feet of warehouse operations in Provo, Utah and creating a fulfillment network spanning the West Coast, Mountain West and East Coast. Today, AMS operates a national, multi-site fulfillment network, serving a roster of leading beauty, apparel and consumer brands with the scale, technology and high-touch service that position the Company for its next chapter of growth as part of Stord.

“As a B-Corp, AMS was built on an employee centric culture focused on providing the best service to our customers in an environmentally sustainable manner. In Fort Point, we found a partner who helped us further our impact and improve our services to customers while supporting the growth of the Company,” said Jay Catlin, co-founder of AMS Fulfillment.

“I am grateful for the support Fort Point provided during their hold and excited about the future for AMS. The Fort Point team provided strong M&A support and steady strategic guidance enabling us to invest in our technology, people and customers. We look forward to continuing to serve our customers under the Stord banner offering best-in-class fulfillment services,” said Greg Morello, Chief Executive Officer of AMS Fulfillment.

“We are proud of all that the AMS team has accomplished during our hold and are excited to see the continued growth of the Company. They showed a clear commitment to exceptional service and long-term relationships while executing against the growth plan and building a highly valuable company,” said Fort Point Partner, Christina Pai.

Lincoln International served as exclusive financial advisor to AMS, while Kirkland & Ellis LLP provided legal counsel to the Company.
